text: Planning a trip can be just as exciting as the journey itself. Pouring over maps and booking flights fills you with anticipation. Once you arrive, you are immediately immersed in new cultures, where daily routines and traditions might be completely different. Tasting local food is an adventure of its own, from bustling street markets to quiet family-run restaurants. Of course, language barriers will arise, and you might find yourself communicating with hand gestures and smiles more than words. In the end, these funny and challenging moments create the strongest memories, reminding you that stepping out of your comfort zone is always worth it.
